notes: The large rustdoc JSON and all command logs remain outside the repository; no evidence artifact at or above 1 MiB is committed.

Prepared owner routes use Arc-held source/profile state for O(1) edit entry and exact no-op replay; edit entry validates only scalar options, while profile-wide limits are deferred to commit (including no-op commits), and changed replay is read back before publication.
LimitKind maps every stable action budget resource, including retained source admission, through the actual limit-error helper rather than remaining declaration-only vocabulary.
The glossary collision is reported as a diagnostic for the resolver/checker follow-up; no public alias or proc-macro workaround was introduced.
